name: NextGen Tools

sources.title: Homepage — weekly launch competition, 'Launch Your Tool Today, Get a Badge & 70+ DR Backlink', 4,003+ tools in launch queue
How it works — submission fields, badge-based verification, 70 launches/week, voting rules, karma/streaks, bids
Pricing — Basic free; Premium $29 one-time; TikTok+Blog feature $199; Featured Spots and Submission Service upsells
My tools — submission/management entry behind account

conditions: Basic Launch is free forever but joins a queue — 4,003+ tools waiting; ~70 tools launch per week
Free-tier dofollow backlink only for weekly Top 3 winners AND requires embedding their badge for verification
Verified checkmark requires embedding the tool's badge on the submitted website — auto-verified when the badge loads on the matching URL
Premium $29 skips the queue, guarantees 2 permanent DR70+ dofollow backlinks, 1 week featured placement
requirements: Account required; submission form needs: tool name, tagline, website URL, logo image, one or more categories, pricing model
Any registered user can upvote; self-upvoting/vote manipulation is prohibited and can cancel the launch
Launches run on a weekly competition cycle (Mon–Sun); top 3 get badges, backlink, +1 extra week featured
preparation: Tool name, tagline, URL, logo, categories, pricing model
Badge embed code ready (from the tool page's 'Embed Badge') for verification + Top-3 backlink eligibility
Decision: free queue vs $29 Premium vs $199 TikTok+Blog feature
workflow: Open the launch submission (~/my-tools / 'Launch your tool') and fill name, tagline, URL, logo, categories, pricing model
Choose Basic (free, queue) or Premium ($29, skip queue)
Embed the badge on your site to earn the verified checkmark
Compete in the weekly ranking; Top 3 win badges + dofollow backlink + an extra featured week
Optional upsells: homepage bid auction (from $1, outbid to lose), Featured Spot monthly subscription, $199 TikTok+Blog feature, directory submission service
watchFor: Queue is deep — 4,003+ tools waiting at ~70/week means a multi-month wait on the free plan
Dofollow backlink on free tier is gated behind Top-3 finish AND badge embed — most free launches get neither
Vote manipulation (including self-upvoting) can cancel your launch — don't game it
Homepage Bids are non-refundable: being outbid leaves you nothing, no credit, no refund
Long streak rewards exist (14-day streak = 25% off Premium; 180-day = 75% off) if you'll engage anyway
Many upsell surfaces: Featured Spots, bids, TikTok package, submission service
countsAsLive: Tool has a public page at nxgntools.com/tools/<slug> and appears in 'This week's launches' during its competition week
unknowns: Whether Premium's 'unlimited SEO-optimized articles' are self-serve or editorial
Exact queue position mechanics for free launches
How Featured Spot's '$1 CPC until outbid' accounting works in practice
